import json, os
import psycopg
job='bcba0db7-3f46-4748-a0e2-a9b6e4c24d6b'
url=os.getenv('APP_DB_URL','').strip()
with psycopg.connect(url) as conn:
  with conn.cursor() as cur:
    cur.execute("""
      select j.job_id, j.status, j.created_at, j.updated_at, j.total_items,
             coalesce(j.user_name,''), coalesce(j.user_id,''),
             coalesce(jm.mode,''), coalesce(jm.screening_types_json,''), coalesce(jm.mock_screening::text,''), coalesce(jm.business_unit_code,'')
      from jobs j
      left join job_metadata jm on jm.job_id=j.job_id
      where j.job_id=%s
    """, (job,))
    r=cur.fetchone()
    print('JOB_META', json.dumps({'job_id':r[0],'job_status':r[1],'created_at':r[2],'updated_at':r[3],'total_items':r[4],'user_name':r[5],'user_id':r[6],'mode':r[7],'screening_types_json':r[8],'mock_screening':r[9],'business_unit_code':r[10]} if r else None))
print('JOB_META_DONE')
